label: Clause 1
description: People Present at the Opening Meeting.

label: Clause 2
description: People who provided assistance during the audit.

label: Clause 3
description: People Present at the Closing Meeting.

label: Clause 4
description: Description of Facility.

label: Clause 5
description: Location audited during visit and description of operations.

label: Clause 7
description: Product forms and classifications of dietary supplements manufactured at this site under NSF/ANSI 455 GMP Certification Program.

label: Clause 8
description: US FDA facility and Bioterrorism registrations and process filings shall be current and maintained. (physical address, scope, expiration dates, etc.) [21CFR111.10 (b1), (b2),(b3)]

label: Clause 9
description: Hygienic practices shall be established to include appropriate garments, personal hygiene, hand washing, and sanitization, etc. prior to starting work and at any time whereby personnel can become soiled or contaminated. [21CFR111.10(b1),(b2),(b3)]

label: Clause 10
description: Procedures shall be in place for use of impermeable gloves, hairnets, caps, beard covers, etc. and for restrictions on the use of food, drinks, tobacco, etc. in areas whereby product contamination could occur. Procedures shall be established to prevent contamination from all potential sources. [21CFR111.10(b5), (b6), (b8), (b9)]

label: Clause 11
description: Procedures shall be established that define work requirements for personnel to prevent microbial contamination due to a health condition. [21CFR111.10(a)]

label: Clause 12
description: Procedures shall be in place for the control of jewelry and other personal care items. [21CFR111.10(b4)]

label: Clause 13
description: Management shall conduct biennial reviews to assess the suitability and effectiveness of the quality system.

label: Clause 14
description: Visitor (regulator, contractor, customer, non-site employee, etc.) policy and procedures shall be established.

label: Clause 15
description: Procedures shall be established for the responsibilities of the QC operations. [21CFR111.103 and 21CFR111.105]

label: Clause 16
description: Quality control (QC) operations shall be identified and implemented. [21CFR111.65]

label: Clause 17
description: Quality responsibilities shall be distinct and separate from operations. [21CFR111.12(b)]

label: Clause 18
description: QC operations and responsibilities shall include the authority to reject any component or product if any specification is not met. [21CFR111.113(a)]

label: Clause 19
description: Procedures shall be established to determine the requirements and qualifications (such as education, training, or experience) for personnel who will supervise activities. [21CFR111.13(a), (b) & 21CFR 117.4]

label: Clause 20
description: Personnel shall be qualified and have adequate training, experience and/or education necessary to perform job functions. [21CFR111.12 (c) & 21CFR 117.4]

label: Clause 21
description: Controls shall be in place to verify the backgrounds of new, contracted, seasonal and temporary employees prior to hiring.

label: Clause 22
description: Sanitation supervisors shall be assigned and shall be qualified. [21CFR111.15(k)]

label: Clause 23
description: Competent supervisory personnel shall be responsible for ensuring transportation operations are conducted in compliance with 21CFR 1.908. [21CFR1.908]

label: Clause 24
description: Job descriptions shall be available for all personnel and personnel have received food safety, GMP, and appropriate training for their assigned functions. [21CFR111.12(a) & 21CFR117.4]

label: Clause 25
description: Records shall be maintained documenting compliance to established procedures that ensure that supervisors are appropriately qualified by education, training, or experience. [21CFR111.14(a), (b) & 21CFR 117.4]

label: Clause 26
description: A document control program shall be established and followed outlining the initiation, formatting, review, approval, distribution (to include personnel training requirements), document storage, change control, retention, and disposal of documents and records. [21CFR111.105]

label: Clause 27
description: Good documentation practices shall be established and followed concerning paper and electronic documents and records. [21CFR111.105]

label: Clause 28
description: Procedures shall be established that describe the requirements for record retention under Subpart P - Records and Recordkeeping. [21CFR111.605]

label: Clause 29
description: All records shall be maintained as original record, as true copies or as electronic records. [21CFR111.605(b)]

label: Clause 30
description: Electronic GMP inventory records that are created, modified, maintained, archived, retrieved, or distributed by a computer system, shall be 21CFR11 compliant. [21CFR11]

label: Clause 31
description: Backup electronic files shall be maintained of the following; current software programs, outdated software programs that may be necessary to retrieve past records, and data that was entered. Backup files shall be an exact and complete record and are secure from alterations, erasures, or loss and damage. [21CFR111.35(b5i), (b5ii)]

label: Clause 32
description: QC operations shall prepare and maintain all records required by Subpart F - Production and Process Control System: Requirements for Quality Control. [21CFR111.140]

label: Clause 33
description: QC operations shall maintain appropriate records as required. [21CFR111.325]

label: Clause 34
description: Records required by 21 CFR 111 shall be maintained for at least one year after the shelf life date or at least two years beyond the date of distribution of the last batch associated with those records. [21CFR111.605(a)]

label: Clause 35
description: A crisis management plan is developed to manage significant disruptive events, including, but not limited to, natural disasters and catastrophic events that may impact the ability of the manufacturer to deliver a safe product.

label: Clause 36
description: Procedures shall be established to define the recall of a product. The written recall plan shall include procedures that describe the steps to be taken, and assign responsibility for taking those steps as appropriate to the facility. [21CFR117.139]

label: Clause 37
description: Procedures shall be established to define traceability and mock recall exercises at a minimum of once a year to include trace forward and trace backward

label: Clause 38
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: Procedures shall be established for a corrective and preventative action (CAPA) program for handling all nonconformances identified within the scope of this Standard.

label: Clause 39
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: QC operations shall ensure product complaints and deviations/unplanned occurrences are handled properly. [21CFR111.135]

label: Clause 40
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: Procedures shall be established describing how product complaints will be received, investigated, and documented and that the product complaint information includes adequate information. [21CFR111.553 & 21CFR111.570(b2ii)]

label: Clause 41
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: All product complaints shall be reviewed by a qualified person to determine if the complaint was the result of a failure of the dietary supplement to meet any of its specifications or quality. [21CFR111.560(a)]

label: Clause 42
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: The decision to investigate a complaint as well as the final decision as a result of the investigation, including corrective action, shall be approved by the QC unit. [21CFR111.560(b)]

label: Clause 43
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: The investigation for a product complaint shall be appropriately extended to other batches, products, processes, etc. [21CFR111.560(c)]

label: Clause 44
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: Records for each product complaint and investigation shall be maintained. Records shall be maintained for at least one year after the shelf life date, if shelf life dating is being used, or at least two years beyond the date of distribution of the last batch associated with those records. [21CFR111.570(a)]

label: Clause 45
section: Corrective and Preventive Actions and Complaints (Section C)
description: An internal audit program shall be established and is conducted. QC personnel shall have established roles and responsibilities. [21CFR111.105]

label: Clause 46
description: Supplier qualification procedures shall be established and include initial qualification, periodic examination (requalification), and procedures for disqualification. [21CFR111.75(a2iiA), (b), (c), (d), (e)]

label: Clause 47
description: A risk-based supplier qualification program is established and implemented for all ingredients. The program includes a supplier/ingredient risk evaluation, appropriate qualification activities as determined by the risk evaluation, and assurance that only approved suppliers are used. [21CFR117.405 & 21CFR117.410]

label: Clause 48
description: A planned deviation process shall be established to expedite the approval of raw materials, packaging materials, and other component suppliers as necessary on an emergency basis.

label: Clause 49
description: Direct importers of components, bulk dosage forms, or finished dietary supplements shall be established and implemented a foreign supplier verification program (FSVP). [21CFR1.511]

label: Clause 50
description: Receiving, sampling, testing, release procedures shall be established to fulfill Subpart G - Production and Process Control System: Requirements for Components, Packaging, and Label. [21CFR111.153]

label: Clause 51
description: Dietary ingredients shall be sampled, tested, and released prior to use in production. Conduct at least one appropriate test or examination to verify the identity of the dietary ingredient (unless the company has submitted a petition for an ID test exemption that has approved by the FDA). [21CFR111.75(a1)]

label: Clause 52
description: Other raw materials or components (i.e., those that are not dietary ingredients) shall be sampled, tested (or confirmed), and released prior to use in production. Conduct appropriate tests or examinations (or rely on Certificate of Analysis (COA) from the qualified supplier). [21CFR111.75(a2i)]

label: Clause 53
description: Packaging and labeling materials shall be visually examined, at a minimum, and shall be reviewed against the supplier's invoice, guarantee, or certification to determine conformance with specifications. [21CFR111.75(f) & 21CFR111.155]

label: Clause 54
description: For products that are received for packaging and labeling, visual examinations shall be performed, and documentation is available to determine whether the product meets established specifications. [21CFR111.75(e)]

label: Clause 55
description: QC operations shall review and approve components, labels and packaging materials for intended use. [21CFR111.120]

label: Clause 56
description: QC requirements shall be established for packaging materials and labels. [21CFR111.160]

label: Clause 57
description: QC requirements shall be established for products that are received for packaging and labeling as a dietary supplement and bulk finished product. [21CFR111.165]

label: Clause 58
description: Receiving records shall be made and kept for components, packaging, and labels, and for products received for packaging and labeling. [21CFR111.180]

label: Clause 59
description: A hazard analysis shall be conducted to identify and evaluate known or reasonably foreseeable hazards for each type of dietary supplement to determine whether there are hazards requiring specifications and process controls. [21CFR111.70 & 21CFR117.130]

label: Clause 60
description: A food allergen control program shall be in place.

label: Clause 61
description: The production facility shall be maintained in a clean and sanitary condition and in a proper state of repair. [21CFR111.15(b1), (b2)]

label: Clause 62
description: Procedures shall be established for cleaning of the plant. [21CFR111.16]

label: Clause 63
description: Cleaning and sanitizing compounds shall be established for cleaning the facility. These agents shall be safe and adequate under the conditions of use; and shall be free of organisms that are of public health significance. [21CFR111.15 (c1), 21CFR111.27(d6), & 21CFR117.35(b1)]

label: Clause 64
description: Cleaning and sanitizing agents, lubricants, pesticides, chemicals, and fungicides shall be identified, used, and held and stored in a manner that protects against adulteration of raw materials and in-process or finished products, and against contamination of processing equipment, utensils, and packaging materials. [21CFR111.15(c3)]

label: Clause 65
description: Procedures for maintenance, cleaning, and sanitization of all equipment, utensils, and contact surfaces are established and records of sanitation shall be maintained. [21CFR111.35(a), (b1iii) & 21CFR111.25(c)]

label: Clause 66
description: Procedures shall be established for cleaning and sanitizing all filling and packaging equipment and utensils. [21CFR111.415(a)]

label: Clause 67
description: All equipment, instruments, utensils, contact surfaces, etc., shall be maintained, cleaned and sanitized (to include disassembly as required by procedure) as necessary. [21CFR111.27(d)]

label: Clause 68
description: Portable equipment and utensils shall be properly stored after cleaning and sanitization. [21CFR111.27(d7)]

label: Clause 69
description: Surfaces that do not come into direct contact with components or dietary supplements shall be cleaned. [21CFR111.27(d4)]

label: Clause 70
description: Manufacturing operations shall be conducted using adequate sanitation principles. [21CFR111.360]

label: Clause 71
description: Throughout the manufacturing process precautions shall be taken to prevent contamination, such as microbial, filth, chemical, foreign material, etc. [21CFR111.365(a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f), (g)]

label: Clause 72
description: Manufacturing operations shall include controls in manufacturing steps to prevent contamination, including metal detection. [21CFR111.365(h), (i)]

label: Clause 73
description: Weighing operations shall be done in a controlled area so as to not cause contamination.

label: Clause 74
description: Low moisture processing: Equipment, utensils, and contact surfaces shall be dry and sanitized. If wet-cleaned, drying and sanitization shall be performed. [21CFR111.27(d2)]

label: Clause 75
description: Wet processing: Contact surfaces shall be cleaned and sanitized before use and after any interruptions. [21CFR111.27(d3)]

label: Clause 76
description: The use of wood and non-wood pallets is controlled to prevent possible contamination of exposed raw materials and products

label: Clause 77
description: A master site plan or facility diagram/floor plan shall be on file reflecting the current layout of the building.

label: Clause 78
description: All facilities shall be of adequate size, construction, and design for their intended use. [21CFR111.20(a)]

label: Clause 79
description: Areas shall be clearly defined with adequate space to allow for effective receiving, inspection, holding and staging, component and finished good quarantine, finished goods, dietary supplements, packaging, and labeling. [21CFR111.20(b), (c1), (c2), (c3)]

label: Clause 80
description: There shall be adequate precautions against contamination by microorganisms, chemicals, filth, or other extraneous materials. [21CFR111.20(c)]

label: Clause 81
description: In areas where open vessels are used, there shall be adequate protection against contamination including the use of protective coverings, physical location, use of skimming equipment. [21CFR111.20(g)]

label: Clause 82
description: Areas shall be separate for laboratory analysis and supplies. [21CFR111.20 (c4), (c5), (c6), (c7)]

label: Clause 83
description: Appropriate changing rooms shall be available and have adequate storage of personal effects. [21CFR111.10(67)]

label: Clause 84
description: Working areas shall have adequate access and space, aisles are clear, etc. to allow for persons to perform their duties and protect against contamination or mix-ups. Use of fans and other air-blowing equipment shall be located and operated in a manner that minimizes the potential for contamination with particulates and microorganisms. [21CFR111.20(d1v), 21CFR111.20(d2)]

label: Clause 85
description: Production area walls, floors, ceilings shall be adequately cleaned and shall be kept in good repair. [21CFR111.20(d1i)]

label: Clause 86
description: Toilet and hand washing facilities shall be provided, shall be of adequate number and location, shall be kept clean, and shall not be a potential source of contamination to components, products, contact surfaces, etc. [21CFR111.15(h)]

label: Clause 87
description: Hand washing facilities shall be constructed and located in appropriate areas to ensure proper hand washing of personnel. [21CFR111.15(i)]

label: Clause 88
description: Equipment shall be of appropriate design and construction (corrosion-resistant, made of non-toxic materials, seamless (if seams exist, are easily cleanable and do not provide a place for accumulation of potential contaminants)) so as to not contaminate components, products, or contact surfaces with lubricants, fuel, coolants, metal or glass fragments, filth or any extraneous materials, contaminated water, or other contaminants. Equipment shall be installed and maintained to facilitate cleaning and are inspected at routine intervals for signs of wear, damage, etc. [21CFR111.27(a3i), (a3ii), (a3iii)]

label: Clause 89
description: Utensil surfaces shall be corrosion-resistant, made of nontoxic materials, maintained to facilitate cleaning, and are inspected at routine intervals for signs of wear, damage, etc. [21 CFR § 111.27(a3i), (a3ii), (a3iii)]

label: Clause 90
description: For any automated, mechanical, or electronic equipment the manufacturer shall have established appropriate controls to ensure that equipment functions in accordance with its intended use, including power backup for critical systems. [21CFR111.30(e)]

label: Clause 91
description: Automated, mechanical, laboratory or electronic equipment shall be suitable for intended use, functioning properly, and be adequately designed. [21CFR111.30(a), (b), (c), (d), (e)]

label: Clause 92
description: Equipment logbooks shall be maintained for each equipment and include the date of use, and any documentation of cleaning, sanitization, maintenance, etc. (unless the documentation is in the batch record). [21CFR111.35(b2)]

label: Clause 93
description: Documentation shall be maintained of the controls used that ensure that equipment functions in accordance with its intended use. [21CFR111.35(b6)]

label: Clause 94
description: Disposable items (single-service) shall be stored in appropriate containers; handled, used, dispensed, and disposed of in a manner that protects against contamination. [21CFR111.27(d5)]

label: Clause 95
description: Fixtures, ducts, piping, etc., are kept clean, shall not drip or leak or provide a source of condensation that could contaminate components, products, or product contact surfaces. [21CFR111.20(d1ii)]

label: Clause 96
description: Plumbing shall be of adequate size and design for the intended usage. [21CFR111.15(f)]

label: Clause 97
description: The water supply and delivery system shall be safe and sanitary. Water that may contact a product contact surface or is, in fact, a component shall meet U.S. federal, state and local requirements for drinking water. [21CFR111.15(e), (f3) & 21CFR 117.37(a)]

label: Clause 98
description: Water sources shall not act as a potential source of contamination of the dietary supplement, either due to water purity or due to the configuration and construction of the water delivery system.

label: Clause 99
description: Records shall be maintained to show that the quality of water, when used as a component of the dietary supplement, meets the requirements of 111.15(e2). [21CFR111.23(c)]

label: Clause 100
description: Floor drainage shall be adequate providing immediate and continuous drainage, with no pooling and equipped with proper drain covers, etc. [21CFR111.15(f4)]

label: Clause 101
description: Backflow and cross-connection prevention shall be in place.

label: Clause 102
description: Waste treatment and disposal shall be adequate and does not provide a source of potential contamination. [21CFR111.15(a4)]

label: Clause 103
description: Solid waste and trash shall be disposed of appropriately, not allowed to accumulate, and does not provide a potential source of contamination to components, products, contact surfaces, etc. [21CFR111.15(j)]

label: Clause 104
description: Hazardous waste shall be properly controlled so as not to provide a potential source of contamination to components, products, contact surfaces, etc. [21CFR111.15(j4)]

label: Clause 105
description: Sewage and waste disposal shall be properly plumbed from the facility and does not provide a potential source of contamination to contact surfaces, products, components, water supplies, etc. [21CFR111.15(g)]

label: Clause 106
description: Adequate ventilation and airflow shall be provided in all areas of the facility. [21CFR111.20(d1iii)]

label: Clause 107
description: Process gases that are used and contact dietary supplements, components, and contact surfaces shall be controlled so as not to cause contamination (e.g., filters). [21CFR111.27(a7)]

label: Clause 108
description: Adequate lighting shall be provided in all production areas, examination areas, where equipment is cleaned, examined, etc.

label: Clause 109
description: Lighting that shall be suspended or located above areas where materials or equipment are exposed shall use safety-type bulbs or the facility shall be constructed in a manner that will protect against contamination with glass, etc. [21CFR111.20(f)]

label: Clause 110
description: Temperature and humidity control equipment shall be of adequate design for its intended function and is functioning properly. [21CFR111.20(d1iv)]

label: Clause 111
description: Procedures and programs shall be established for maintaining equipment including for calibration of all instruments, controls, automated, mechanical, laboratory, and electronic equipment, etc. [21CFR111.25]

label: Clause 112
description: Instruments and controls that are important to product quality and safety shall be accurate and precise, adequately maintained, and adequate in number. [21CFR111.27(a6)]

label: Clause 113
description: Complete records shall be made and kept of any calibration of instruments and controls that are important to product quality and safety. [21CFR111.35(b3)]

label: Clause 114
description: QC operations reviews and approves all processes and/or procedures for calibrating equipment, instruments, and controls; including the periodic review of calibration records, etc. [21CFR111.117]

label: Clause 115
description: Procedures shall be established to prevent entrance to the facility by pests and animals, including screens and barriers, rodent traps, insect traps or lights, etc. [21CFR111.15(d1),(d2)]

label: Clause 116
description: Grounds shall be properly maintained through the removal of litter and waste, cutting of grass and weeds adjacent to the plant, maintenance of roads and parking lots, providing adequate drainage, etc. [21CFR111.15(a1), (a2), (a3)]

label: Clause 117
description: Entrances to the facilities shall be properly controlled and maintained to prevent contamination. [21CFR111.15(a5)]

label: Clause 118
description: Pest control procedures shall be established for the appropriate use of any insecticides, fungicides, fumigants, rodenticides, etc. [21CFR111.15(d3)]

label: Clause 119
description: Production areas shall not provide harborage for pests, pest infestation, filth, etc. (e.g., adequate screening and other measures are used). [21CFR111.20(h)]

label: Clause 120
description: Records shall be maintained for plant cleaning and pest control in accordance with Subpart P - Records and Recordkeeping. [21CFR111.23(a), (b)]

label: Clause 121
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Production and process control systems shall be implemented for each production process and/or product. [21CFR111.55]

label: Clause 122
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: QC operations and authority shall be established for master manufacturing record and batch production record. [21CFR111.123(a1), (a2),(a3)]

label: Clause 123
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Manufacturing processes shall be designed to produce a product that consistently meets specifications. [21CFR111.355]

label: Clause 124
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Production and processes shall be designed to ensure the quality of the product and the QC unit has approved the control systems. [21CFR111.60]

label: Clause 125
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Master manufacturing records shall be prepared for each unique formulation and batch size of the dietary supplement. [21CFR111.205(a)]

label: Clause 126
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: The master record shall identify specifications for the control points, steps, or stages in the manufacturing process where control is necessary to ensure the quality of the dietary supplement. [21CFR111.205(b1), (b2)]

label: Clause 127
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Master manufacturing records shall contain all the required elements as defined in 21 CFR111.210. [21CFR111.210]

label: Clause 128
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: For each manufactured batch of dietary supplement, the batch production record shall accurately follow the master manufacturing record with all steps being performed, and it shall contain complete information related to the production and control of the batch. Batch production records shall be maintained for at least one year after the shelf life date, if shelf life dating is being used, or at least two years beyond the date of distribution of the last batch associated with those records. [21CFR111.255]

label: Clause 129
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: The batch record shall follow the master record and each step shall be performed appropriately. [21CFR111.260]

label: Clause 130
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Manufacturing operations shall include the identification of all process lines and major equipment used during manufacturing to indicate their contents, including the name of the dietary supplement and the specific batch or lot number, and when necessary, the phase of manufacturing. [21CFR111.365(j), (k)]

label: Clause 131
section: Production and Process Controls - Manufacturing Operations (Section G)
description: Records shall be established and shall be maintained to meet the requirements of Subpart K - Production and Process Control System: Requirements for Manufacturing Operations. [21CFR111.375]

label: Clause 132
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: A master manufacturing record shall include instructions for filling, assembling, packaging, labeling, and other related operations. [21CFR111.415]

label: Clause 133
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Packaging and labeling materials shall be examined before usage to determine that they conform to the master manufacturing record. [21CFR111.410(c)]

label: Clause 134
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established for all packaging and labeling operations. [21CFR111.403]

label: Clause 135
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: QC operations shall be established for packaging and labeling. [21CFR111.127]

label: Clause 136
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Filling and packaging operations shall be appropriately protected from contamination sources (e.g., airborne) by using sanitary procedures. [21CFR111.415(b), (c)]

label: Clause 137
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Packaging and labeling of the finished packaged and labeled dietary supplement shall be visually examined, at a minimum, to determine that the correct packaging and labeling has been used. [21CFR111.75(g)]

label: Clause 138
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: The condition of the packaging shall meet the specifications required to ensure the quality of the dietary supplements being packaged. [21CFR111.410(a)]

label: Clause 139
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Packaging and labels shall be controlled for issuance and are reconciled after use. [21CFR111.410(b)]

label: Clause 140
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Separation shall be implemented to prevent mix-ups with other components and dietary supplements. [21CFR111.415(d)]

label: Clause 141
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established to identify unlabeled materials that will be held for future labeling operations to prevent mix-ups. [21CFR111.415(e)]

label: Clause 142
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established for assigning a lot or batch number for each lot of packaged and labeled dietary supplement. [21CFR111.415(f)]

label: Clause 143
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Disposal procedures shall be established for disposing of labels or packaging materials that are obsolete or incorrect to ensure that they are not used. [21CFR111.415(h)]

label: Clause 144
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: All repackaging or relabeling operations shall be first approved by the QC unit. [21CFR111.420(a)]

label: Clause 145
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Representative samples of each batch of repackaged or relabeled dietary supplement shall be examined to determine if they conform to specifications. [21CFR111.420(b)]

label: Clause 146
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: QC unit shall disposition each batch of repackaged or relabeled dietary supplement prior to release for distribution. [21CFR111.420(c)]

label: Clause 147
section: Production and Process Controls - Packaging Operations (Section G)
description: Records shall be established and are being maintained to meet the requirements of Subpart L - Product and Process Control System: Requirements for Packaging and Labeling Operations. [21CFR111.430]

label: Clause 148
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: A system shall be established to determine if all specifications that are established have been met. [21CFR111.73]

label: Clause 149
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Specifications shall be established for components, in-process materials, labels, packaging components, and finished product. The basis is adequately documented for how meeting the in-process specifications, in combination with meeting component specifications, will help ensure that the dietary supplement specifications will be met. [21CFR111.70]

label: Clause 150
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Records shall be maintained of specifications, supplier qualification, and testing to ensure product meets purity, strength and composition. [21CFR111.95]

label: Clause 151
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established for the collection of representative samples. [21CFR111.80]

label: Clause 152
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established to sample a representative number of units to assure compliance with specifications. [21CFR111.415(g)]

label: Clause 153
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Samples shall be collected in a controlled area so as to not cause contamination

label: Clause 154
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established for the collection of reserve samples for each lot of finished material. [21CFR111.83]

label: Clause 155
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Reserve samples shall be held under appropriate conditions (e.g., temperature, humidity, and light) and shall not lead to a mix-up, contamination, or deterioration. [21CFR111.465]

label: Clause 156
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: QC operations shall determine if process and product specifications have been met. The product shall not be released if it does not meet the specifications, unless QC approved deviations have been documented. [21 CFR § 111.123(a), (b)]

label: Clause 157
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: The QC person shall be responsible for making the material review and disposition decision shall document the review and disposition decision at the time of performance. [21CFR111.113(c)]

label: Clause 158
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Proper testing procedures or programs shall be established to determine if in-process and finished product specifications for purity, composition, and strength of the dietary supplement have been met. The basis for performing reduced-testing shall be adequately documented and it justifies how the testing procedures or program selected will help ensure that the full-specification for the dietary supplement will be met. [21CFR111.75(b), (c), (d)]

label: Clause 159
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Procedures and controls shall be established for investigation and handling of materials or processing that do not meet specification requirements. [21CFR111.77]

label: Clause 160
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: QC personnel shall conduct a material review and make disposition decisions to approve treatments, in-process adjustments, and reprocessing when there is a deviation or unanticipated occurrence or when a specification is not met. [21CFR111.90]

label: Clause 161
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: QC personnel shall authorize a treatment, in-process treatment, or reprocessing in an attempt to correct a deviation or unexpected event, or specification deficiency. [21CFR111.113(b)]

label: Clause 162
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Reprocessing controls shall be established and meet all requirements and have been approved by the QC unit. [21CFR111.90(a), (b)]

label: Clause 163
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Any reprocessed material shall meet its original specification and the QC unit appropriately dispositions the material (release or reject). [21CFR111.525]

label: Clause 164
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Documentation shall be maintained for material reviews and dispositions, all testing results, any reevaluations by the QC unit for reprocessed materials. [21CFR111.535(b1), (b2), (b3), (b4)]

label: Clause 165
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Procedures shall be established for the handling of returned dietary supplements that include appropriately quarantining the returned product until dispositioned by the QC unit. Procedures shall be established for salvage and reprocessing operations according to Subpart P - Records and Recordkeeping. [21CFR111.503, 21CFR111.510, & 21CFR111.535(a)]

label: Clause 166
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: QC operations shall be established to handle returned dietary supplements. Any returned dietary supplement shall be either destroyed or disposed of unless the QC unit has determined that the material can be salvaged or reprocessed. Any salvaged material shall be approved by the QC unit following a material review and disposition. [21CFR111.130, 21CFR111.515, & 21CFR111.520]

label: Clause 167
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: If the reason for a return implicates other batches, an investigation shall be performed to determine if those batches comply with specifications. [21CFR111.530]

label: Clause 168
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Records for returned dietary supplements shall be maintained. Records shall be maintained for at least one year after the shelf life date, if shelf life dating is being used, or at least two years beyond the date of distribution of the last batch associated with those records. [21CFR111.535]

label: Clause 169
section: Production and Process Controls - Specifications, Product Release and Returns (Section G)
description: Records shall be maintained to allow a complete history and control of the packaged and labeled dietary supplement through distribution. [21CFR111.410(d)]

label: Clause 170
description: QC laboratory operations and procedures shall be established. [21CFR111.110 & 21CFR111.303]

label: Clause 171
description: Laboratory controls shall be established and have been approved by QC, including criteria for establishing specifications. [21CFR111.315(a)]

label: Clause 172
description: Parameters shall be set for laboratory controls for sampling plans, criteria for examination and testing methods, and standard reference materials. [21CFR111.315(b), (c), (d), (e)]

label: Clause 173
description: QC responsibilities for laboratory test methods and examinations used to test each specification requirement shall be defined, shall be appropriate for their intended use and shall be followed. Test methods and examinations shall be used according to established criteria. [21CFR111.320]

label: Clause 174
description: Laboratory facilities used shall be adequate for testing of components, in-process materials, and dietary supplements. [21CFR111.310]

label: Clause 175
description: Scientifically valid methods shall be used and include at least one of the following: [21CFR111.75(h)]

label: Clause 176
description: For all products that bear expiration date or a statement of product shelf life, the shelf life shall be supported. [Preamble to 21CFR111 final rule]

label: Clause 177
description: Written procedures shall be in place for retesting materials to extend shelf life.

label: Clause 178
description: Procedures shall be established for the holding and distribution operations. [21CFR111.475(b1)]

label: Clause 179
description: Dietary supplements, components, in-process materials, labeling, and packaging shall be held under the appropriate conditions of temperature, humidity, and light. Storage conditions shall not lead to a mix-up, contamination, or deterioration. [21 CFR § 111.455 & 21 CFR § 111.460]

label: Clause 180
description: Equipment such as freezers, refrigerators, etc., that are used to hold components or dietary supplements shall be adequately designed and functioning properly. [21CFR111.27(a5)]

label: Clause 181
description: Distribution of product shall occur under conditions that will protect against contamination and deterioration. [21CFR111.470]

label: Clause 182
description: Written procedures shall be in place for transportation operations and shall be conducted to prevent dietary supplements from becoming unsafe during transportation operations. [21CFR1.908]

label: Clause 183
description: Vehicles and transportation equipment shall be designed and constructed of such material and workmanship to prevent dietary supplements transported therein from becoming unsafe, e.g., adulterated during transportation operations. [21CFR1.906]

label: Clause 184
description: Product distribution records shall be retained. Records shall be maintained for at least one year after the shelf life date, if shelf life dating is being used, or at least two years beyond the date of distribution of the last batch associated with those records. [21CFR111.475(b2)]

label: Clause 185
description: An appropriate quarantine system shall be established and shall be demonstrated to meet the necessary requirements per procedures. Rejected dietary supplements, components, packaging, labeling, and products shall be removed from manufacturing operations and placed in quarantine until disposition is determined. Records shall be kept for the quarantine system. [21CFR111.170, 21CFR111.370, & 21CFR111.425]

label: Clause 186
description: Prompt and thorough access shall be granted to the auditor during the NSF audit.

label: Clause 187
description: Documents requested during the NSF audit shall be provided in a timely manner.

label: Clause 188
description: The NSF 455 Certification Mark shall not be used on materials, ingredients, components, or finished products

label: Clause 189
description: Products observed being manufactured at the site at the time of the audit.
